biography: Alex Rullo, a name synonymous with daring overtakes and a flamboyant personality, hails from the sun-kissed beaches of Western Australia. His journey into motorsport began not on the track, but on the water, as a competitive jet skier. The raw speed and adrenaline rush translated seamlessly when he transitioned to karting at age 12. His defining moment came early, a stunning last-lap victory at the Australian National Karting Championships, a feat that caught the eye of Fizz Flavor Racing. Now, at 30, Rullo is considered to be at the peak of his career, piloting a cutting-edge machine for Fizz Flavor Racing, constantly pushing the boundaries and captivating audiences with his audacious style.
drivingStyle: Rullo's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos.' He's an aggressive driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to dive down the inside of corners where others wouldn't dare. While this approach has led to spectacular overtakes and podium finishes, it has also resulted in costly errors. He possesses a keen sense of tire management, often able to extract maximum performance from his rubber even in the closing stages of a race. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best results when the stakes are highest.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of socks embroidered with kangaroos during race weekends.
Listens to AC/DC's 'Highway to Hell' precisely three times before every race.
Has a specific ritual of cleaning his visor with a microfiber cloth while reciting the alphabet backwards.
famousQuote: "I don't race for second place. If I can't win, I'd rather crash trying."
careerHighlight: Winning the Bathurst 1000 in 2028 after starting from the back of the grid, showcasing his relentless determination and overtaking prowess.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2027 Australian Grand Prix due to a mechanical failure, costing him a home victory.
